name: elementick
description: Elementick: a stickman elemental 1v1 fighting game for the browser (studio: majen)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node tools/size-report.mjs dist
scripts.build:crazygames: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode crazygames --outDir dist-crazygames && node tools/size-report.mjs dist-crazygames
scripts.build:poki: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode poki --outDir dist-poki && node tools/size-report.mjs dist-poki
